title: Frustration with screen-only controls
summary: Reviews in this topic express strong frustration with replacing traditional buttons for simple functions with screen-based controls, with one owner even considering selling the car and switching brands.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe frustration with screen-controlled basic functions such as heating and dissatisfaction severe enough to consider selling the vehicle or changing brands.

limitations: The sample is very small, so the summary reflects only the supplied examples.
One fragment states frustration without enough detail to identify the specific feature involved.
